classing_rule.OBSERVED_AS_RUN: input identity, release clock, observed clock (a capture receipt stamped by the writer at write time) and correction clock all recorded at capture; any model in the path pinned at decision time; store generation pinned.
classing_rule.PUBLIC_INFO_REPLAY: source-recorded release and correction (vintage-boundary) clocks exist for every input row used; no model of unknown vintage in the path; no capture clock required.
classing_rule.RETROSPECTIVE: a KNOWN, identifiable construction (code blob, selection era, unfitted-but-selected head, or a model of unknown vintage) whose knowledge boundary cannot be proven not to include the future of the decisions it would be applied to. The label names a known construction with an unprovable boundary.
classing_rule.null: a required element is ABSENT or UNIDENTIFIED (no acquired body, no identity, no reconstructable event set, no pinned generation) — nothing to class yet; the consumer is blocked pending the prospective remedy. Every null carries `null_reason` ∈ {NOT_ACQUIRED, IDENTITY_UNPINNED, EVENT_SET_NOT_RECONSTRUCTABLE, GENERATION_UNPINNED, NO_VINTAGE_ROUTE, NOT_APPLICABLE_UNFITTED}.
